findings: The card asked for 20 Gore-Langton URLs. Only 13 of his URL-less reviews exist online: his Mail on Sunday reviews are mostly print-only, and when they are online they usually sit as a short secondary section inside another critic's article.

Method: every article in DM's per-day HTML archive (/home/sitemaparchive/day_YYYYMMDD.html) from 4 days before to 3 days after the Theatre Record date, filtered to theatre-looking slugs, fetched and matched on 6-word shingles of the review text. Real matches score 0.5-1.0 overlap; unrelated pages score 0.

DM bundles reviews: one article carries a lead review plus short secondary reviews of other shows. A URL is written to a review file only when it is the lead (page-level star extraction is then right) or when its section prints its own rating, which is written as originalScore so recollect-for-scores cannot overwrite it with the lead show's stars.

Dead ends: Google SERP and ScrapingBee SERP (not indexed), DM site search (broken), /home/event/index.rss (frozen in 2022), XML day sitemaps (about a third of articles, no /home/event/), aggregator archives (no DM links for these).
